Dragon Duelists who make the Top 8 cut in the Dragon Duel World Championship Qualifier receive a similar game mat.

After choosing a background, the attendees pose in front of the greenscreen to have their photograph taken.

The Token Booth isn’t at every Yu-Gi-Oh! event, but when it comes around to an event you attend, make sure to capture your awesome memories of the event with your very own Token card!
